description: This file defines the `Attribute` class, which models product attributes in a shopping system, including properties like name, type, code, values, and a read-only value.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a product attribute with properties such as name, type, code, list of values, and a read-only value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attribute.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the attribute.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the attribute.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets the list of attribute values.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of attribute values.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the attribute.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the attribute.
